I have implemented the `EventListener.BatchDurable` callback, durability tracking, wait APIs, notifications, stats, and metrics on a new branch (`batch-durable`) and committed all changes.

### Summary of Changes

- **EventListener & Options** ([event.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/event.go), [options.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/options.go)):
  - Added [`BatchDurableInfo`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/event.go#L1031-L1040) with `JobID`, `SeqNum`, `Err`, `ApplyDuration`, `SyncDuration`, `CorrelationID`, `BatchSize`, and `KeyCount`.
  - Added `BatchDurable func(BatchDurableInfo)` to [`EventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/event.go#L924-L1028) and wired it through [`EnsureDefaults`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/event.go#L1073-L1170), [`MakeLoggingEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/event.go#L1174-L1263), and [`TeeEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/event.go#L1266-L1389).
  - Added `CommitCorrelationID uint64` to [`WriteOptions`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/options.go#L395-L412).
- **Commit Pipeline & Batch Integration** ([batch.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/batch.go), [commit.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/commit.go), [db.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/db.go), [open.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/open.go)):
  - Separated apply/publish duration measurement from the WAL sync wait phase in [`commitPipeline.Commit`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/commit.go#L299-L368) and [`Batch.SyncWait`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/batch.go#L1748-L1764).
  - Recorded durability completion and invoked `BatchDurable` exactly once per `Sync` commit after WAL sync completes (including on failure), while ignoring non-sync commits and `DisableWAL`.
- **Durability Tracking, Wait APIs, and Metrics** ([durability.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/durability.go), [metrics.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/metrics.go), [durability_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/durability_test.go)):
  - Implemented [`WaitForDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/durability.go#L514-L516), [`WaitForDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/durability.go#L522-L524), [`WaitForDurabilityBatch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/durability.go#L528-L530), [`WaitForDurabilityBatchContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/durability.go#L536-L550), [`WaitForJobDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/durability.go#L555-L557), [`WaitForJobDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/durability.go#L563-L565), [`DurableState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/durability.go#L569-L571), [`DurabilityNotify`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/durability.go#L576-L578), and [`DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/durability.go#L582-L584).
  - Added `DurableCommitCount` and `DurableCommitDuration` to [`Metrics`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-9762g53g/metrics.go#L382-L390), accumulated only when `BatchDurable` is configured.
